description_en: Creates an automatic shutdown policy for a specified instance to automatically stop the Data Science Workshop (DSW) instance when specific conditions are met. Only one idle automatic shutdown policy is supported per DSW instance. If an idle automatic shutdown policy is already configured for the specified instance, call DeleteIdleInstanceCuller to delete it first
description_zh: 创建指定实例的自动关机策略，满足条件时将自动停止DSW实例。一个DSW实例只支持创建一个闲置自动关机策略，如果指定实例已设定过闲置自动关机策略，请先调用DeleteIdleInstanceCuller将其删除
name: CreateIdleInstanceCuller

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance for which you want to configure the automatic shutdown policy. For more information about how to obtain the instance ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/470439.html
parameters.help_zh: 设定自动关机的实例ID。如何获取实例ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/470439.html
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The CPU utilization threshold, in percentage. Valid values: 1 to 100. If the CPU utilization is lower than this value, the instance is considered idle
parameters.help_zh: CPU使用率阈值，单位是百分比，取值1~100，低于此值则认为实例当前处于闲置
parameters.name: cpu_percent_threshold

parameters.help_en: The GPU utilization threshold, in percentage. Valid values: 1 to 100. This parameter takes effect only if the instance is a GPU-accelerated instance. If both the CPU and GPU utilization are lower than the specified thresholds, the instance is considered idle
parameters.help_zh: GPU使用率阈值，单位是百分比，取值1~100。如果实例为GPU类型，则此参数生效。CPU和GPU同时低于阈值则认为指定实例处于闲置
parameters.name: gpu_percent_threshold

parameters.help_en: The maximum idle time threshold, in minutes. If the idle duration exceeds this value, the DSW instance is automatically stopped
parameters.help_zh: 闲置等待时间阈值，单位是分钟。如果闲置时长超过此值，将自动停止DSW实例
parameters.name: max_idle_time_in_minutes

Code.description_en:
The status code. Valid values:
InternalError: An internal error occurred. All errors other than parameter validation errors are classified as internal errors.
ValidationError: A parameter validation error occurred
Code.description_zh:
状态码，可能值：
InternalError：内部错误（除了参数验证错误外的其他错误，目前都归类到内部错误）。
ValidationError：参数验证错误

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true
false
Success.description_zh:
成功标志，可能值：
true
false
